items.title: Charbel Premieres in Beirut
items.dek: The NMPRO and MTV feature has premiered at Beirut Media Zone. Lebanese cinemas are preparing for October 22; check individual cinemas for sessions.

items.title: Pope Leo has a calm first night after lung surgery
items.credit: The Holy See says Pope Leo had a calm first night after surgery; another update is expected later today. Context photo: Gemelli Hospital, Rome. Photo: Blackcat, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0; resized to WebP.

items.title: Catholics pray for Pope Leo at Gemelli
items.credit: Cardinal Baldassarre Reina led the evening Rosary in the hospital chapel as Catholics prayed for the Pope. Context photo: the Sacro Cuore church at Gemelli, not the Rosary itself. Photo: Pufui PcPifpef, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0; resized to WebP.
